name: Glossary
description: The domain vocabulary a project declares, and the words it rejects in their place.

scenarios.title: A section reaches the files its includes cover
given: a glossary whose sections carry include globs
scenarios.when: the sections are resolved against the base
scenarios.then: each section answers the files its globs cover

scenarios.title: A later term replaces an earlier one of the same name
given: two sections covering one file and declaring the same term
scenarios.when: the effective vocabulary for that file is worked out
scenarios.then: the later term replaces the earlier one outright, its rejected words included

scenarios.title: A missing glossary is a broken reference line
given: a path where no glossary was written
scenarios.then: the path is named as one holding no glossary

scenarios.title: A glossary that will not parse
given: a glossary file that is not readable JSON
scenarios.then: the file is named as unreadable

scenarios.title: A file declaring no glossary at all
given: readable JSON with no glossary in it
scenarios.then: the file is named as declaring no glossary
